Module com.example.farmbook
Package com.example.farmbook

Class Crop

java.lang.Object
com.example.farmbook.Crop
public class Crop extends Object
Crop entity within the Farmbook application. This class stores information about a specific planting record: its name, type, quantity, planting date, and additional notes.

  • Constructor Details

    • Crop

      public Crop(String plantName, String cropType, int amount, String datePlanted, String notes, String location, String status)
      Constructs a new Crop without an ID. So the Database auto-generates it. Used when creating a new record to be inserted into the database,
      Parameters:
      plantName - name of the plant
      cropType - category of the crop
      amount - quantity planted
      datePlanted - date the crop was planted, String
      notes - additional notes about the crop
      location - field/plot location
      status - current growing status

    • Crop

      public Crop(int id, String plantName, String cropType, int amount, String datePlanted, String notes, String location, String status)
      Constructs a Crop with an existing ID. Used when reading an existing record.
      Parameters:
      id - unique identifier for the crop
      plantName - name of the plant
      cropType - category of the crop
      amount - quantity planted
      datePlanted - date the crop was planted, String
      notes - additional notes about the crop
      location - field/plot
      status - Growing, Harvested or Failed
